content: If the AS timer ( FrArTpTimeoutAs ) expires, depending on the value of FrArTpMaxAs , sending shall be retried (because of still remaining attempts) or the transmission shall be aborted , and within PduR_ FrArTp TxConfirmation the result E_NOT_OK shall be returned.

If the AS timer ( FrArTpTimeoutAs ) expires, depending on the value of FrArTpMaxAs , sending shall be retried (because of Specification of FlexRay AUTOSAR Transport Layer AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 47 of 101 Document ID 601 : AUTOSA R_SWS_FlexRayAR TransportLayer still remaining attempts) or the transmission shall be aborted , and within PduR_ FrArTp TxConfirmation the result E_NOT_OK shall be returned.

If the AS timer ( FrArTpTimeoutAs ) expires, depending on the value of FrArTpMaxAs , sending shall be retried (because of Specification of FlexRay AUTOSAR Transport Layer AUTOSAR CP R22 - 11 47 of 109 Document ID 601 : AUTOSA R_SWS_FlexRayAR TransportLayer still remaining attempts) or the transmission shall be aborted , and within PduR_ FrArTp TxConfirmation the result E_NOT_OK shall be returned.
